entries.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs

entries.title: 'They're stealing from the poor': A major source of SNAP fraud robs recipients of millions
entries.snippet: Organized criminal rings target SNAP recipients because of the government program's outdated security features. But upgrading the tech costs money and states' SNAP budgets are getting squeezed.

entries.title: Civil rights advocates plan to send thousands of observers to midterm polling places
entries.snippet: For many election cycles, civil rights groups and political parties have fanned out to monitor polling places, but the charged midterm environment has many organizations stepping up efforts this year.

entries.title: In Kansas, a newly competitive Senate race tests limit of Trump's unpopular policies
entries.snippet: Kansas voters could send a Democrat to the Senate for the first time in nearly a century — and flip the governor's office back to Republican control, even in what could be a tough year for the GOP.

entries.title: Does a Russian lab worker's death carry pandemic risk? Experts say it's unlikely, with one caveat
entries.snippet: Some details surrounding a Russian lab worker's death of an unknown pneumonia parallel COVID-19 news that unfolded seven years ago, but health security experts say they don't see signs this is a precursor to another pandemic.

entries.title: Trump's diesel deal with Putin draws bipartisan criticism from a frustrated Congress
entries.snippet: The deal is being criticized by both Republicans and Democrats as fueling Russia's war against Ukraine, violating existing U.S. laws and drawing the U.S. closer to Russia.

entries.title: CVS agrees to pay $315 million to settle Justice Department case over opioid prescriptions
entries.snippet: The settlement resolves a lawsuit brought in 2024 that accused the healthcare giant of providing massive amounts of opioids and other controlled substances "to fuel its own profits at the expense of public health and safety."

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Utah voters hear from Moore, Crosby in midterm House debate
entries.snippet: Newly drawn congressional districts in Utah mean that when incumbent Republican Rep. Blake Moore meets Democratic challenger Peter Crosby for a debate Tuesday, he'll be speaking to a new amalgam of voters.

entries.snippet: Sen. Jon Ossoff is scheduled to face Republican Rep. Mike Collins Tuesday in a debate for Georgia's key U.S. Senate race.

entries.snippet: President Donald Trump is making an unusual campaign trip with the midterm elections looming.

entries.title: In first visit to Ceuta, Spain's king asks for 'good faith' from Morocco after migration crisis
entries.snippet: Tensions have risen in the Spanish city in North Africa since about 80,000 migrants crossed its border in July.

entries.title: Congo's confirmed Ebola cases surpass 9,000 as containment efforts falter
entries.snippet: Health workers are alarmed, as many deaths occur outside treatment centers.

entries.title: Republicans face midterm backlash from factory workers over Trump's tariffs
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump's tariffs are turning factory workers against his Republican Party over fears the import taxes could lead to fewer jobs instead of the manufacturing renaissance he promised.

entries.title: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis gets 40 years to life in prison for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder

entries.title: DW

entries.title: China's influence in the gaming industry is growing
entries.snippet: Home to more than 700 million gamers, China is the world's largest gaming market — but it's also one of the most tightly regulated. The effects reach far beyond China, impacting players around the world.

entries.title: Nord Stream: Germany puts suspected Ukrainian pipeline saboteur on trial
entries.snippet: A Ukrainian citizen faces court in Hamburg, accused of attacking the Nord Stream gas pipelines in 2022. It raises questions about Kyiv's possible role in the explosions. German support for Ukraine is also under scrutiny.

entries.title: Ukraine says Musk's SpaceX limits Kyiv's Starlink access
entries.snippet: Ukraine accused SpaceX of restricting use of its Starlink system, impacting Kyiv's ability to control its drones as Russian attacks continue unabated.

entries.title: Trump's US Super Intelligence Force and AI czar Jay Clayton
entries.snippet: Trump announced a new Super Intelligence task force with the White House AI czar Jay Clayton in charge of a group responsible for making sure the US leads international competition in artificial intelligence development.

entries.title: Trump announces plans for major oil, gas and mineral exploration in Greenland
entries.snippet: The US president has claimed Greenland holds vast and easily accessible oil reserves without providing evidence or details. His announcement follows a deal expanding the US military presence on the Arctic island.

entries.title: Fact check: Misleading graph about alleged Russian bot activity
entries.snippet: Did attacks on Russian data centers reduce bot activity around Germany's AfD? A viral graph claims they did. But it contains significant inconsistencies and provides no evidence to support the claim.

entries.title: Do non-German nationals commit more crimes than Germans?
entries.snippet: People without German passports appear more frequently in German police crime statistics than German nationals. A new study explains why.

entries.title: FIFPRO report highlights growing pains in women's football
entries.snippet: Expected global revenue of over $1 billion and new faces at the U17 World Cup show women's football is booming, but a recent report also highlights need for greater structure globally.

entries.title: The hidden treasure in discarded wearable and fast tech
entries.snippet: Sales of fast tech like mini fans and disposable e-vapes, as well as wearable health tech such as heart monitors and smartwatches are soaring. They're creating a new e-waste problem but are full of hidden treasure.

entries.title: Iran: Political infighting deepens as economic woes mount during war
entries.snippet: Hardliners are stepping up pressure on Iran's government and calling for Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's removal. The oil minister resigned, but that's doing little to ease the pressure on President Masoud Pezeshkian.

entries.title: India news: 'Cockroach' leaders sent to judicial custody amid protest crackdown
entries.snippet: Three of India's Cockroach movement leaders will spend five days in jail over charges of trespassing into what was until recently a designated protest site. In other news, Marco Rubio is set to visit India.

entries.title: US judge extends media outlets' White House access
entries.snippet: A federal judge extended an order that blocks the Trump administration from banning media outlets from the White House. The outlets have reasonable grounds to think they'll win the case, the judge said.

entries.title: Houthis launch fresh wave of missiles across Saudi Arabia
entries.snippet: Both the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition carried out strikes targeting energy infrastructure. Four people were injured as a result of debris of intercepted missiles in Riyadh. DW has the latest.

entries.title: Cornell suspends frat parties after gang rape case
entries.snippet: Cornell said no parties will be held at frat houses until the end of the academic year. The university is trying to mend its reputation following its handling of a gang rape case in 2024.

entries.title: OpenAI says employee caught planting listening device
entries.snippet: A Saudi national employed by the artificial intelligence lab has been arrested after a listening device was planted in a company conference room.

entries.title: Vatican confirms Pope Leo underwent surgery for lung cancer
entries.snippet: The pope has had part of his lung removed and is recovering after surgery. Leo has been unusually candid for a pontiff about his health issues, disclosing the surgery to thousands of people in St. Peter's Square.

entries.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial: Former gang leader Duane Davis sentenced to 40 years
entries.snippet: Former Los Angeles gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis was found guilty of ordering the killing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur.

entries.title: Germany news: Left-leaning Berlin coalition talks break down
entries.snippet: The SPD and Greens in Berlin have halted exploratory coalition talks with the Left Party amid a dispute over Israel policy and antisemitism. DW has more.

entries.title: Ukraine allies in Poland after Starlink sabotage, Trump diesel deal
entries.snippet: Germany's Johann Wadephul said hybrid plots like the Starlink fire showed Europe was "in Russia's crosshairs." The UK's Ed Miliband said Trump's Russian diesel deal led to a "very difficult few days" diplomatically.
